text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, dacarbazine is not on the FDA shortage list. Corvale East holds 11 vials of 10 mg/mL, 10 mL (2.9 days) and 33 vials of 200 mg (9.1 days). Corvale General holds 45 vials of 10 mg/mL, 10 mL (15.8 days) and 38 vials of 200 mg (13.3 days). Corvale Lakeside holds 9 vials of 10 mg/mL, 10 mL (9.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show dacarbazine is not on the current shortage list as of 2026-10-21; an earlier shortage was first posted 2021-10-20 and is resolved. FDA inspected Fresenius Kabi USA LLC (FEI 1450022) on 2020-05-18 and classified it OAI, 520 days before the 2021-10-20 shortage posting. FDA inspected the same plant on 2022-06-30 and classified it OAI, 253 days after the shortage posting. FDA inspected the plant again on 2023-08-24 and classified it VAI, 673 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: No national shortage exists. Local supply at Corvale East is critically low for the 10 mg/mL, 10 mL presentation. Corvale General has sufficient stock to support a transfer.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 5 vials of 10 mg/mL, 10 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Purchase additional 10 mg/mL, 10 mL vials from Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. — approved by buyer.
3. Use dacarbazine 200 mg vials from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. as an alternate concentration — requires pharmacist verification; previously approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2025-12-17.
4. Use dacarbazine 10 mg/mL vials from Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as an alternate source — requires pharmacist verification; previously approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-09-12.

Not recommended: No further actions at this time.
